business_summary: Food & Life Companies Ltd. operates a chain of sushi restaurants. It also operates restaurants under Sugidama, Kyotaru, Conveyor Belt Sushi Misaki, Kaisen San, and Sushiro brands. The company was formerly known as Sushiro Global Holdings Ltd. and changed its name to Food & Life Companies Ltd. in April 2021. Food & Life Companies Ltd. was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Suita, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Food & Life Companies Ltd.는 스시 레스토랑 체인을 운영하고 있습니다. 또한 Sugidama, Kyotaru, Conveyor Belt Sushi Misaki, Kaisen San 및 Sushiro 브랜드로 레스토랑을 운영하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Sushiro Global Holdings Ltd.로 알려졌으며 2021년 4월에 Food & Life Companies Ltd.로 이름을 변경했습니다. Food & Life Companies Ltd.는 1975년에 설립되었으며 일본 스이타에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
